track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 13: Zanguleh
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Zanguleh in Bayat-e Tork, Chahargah, Mahur, Rast-Panjgah. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gk3 and dwells most on A in Zanguleh. The line peaks at A4 (444.3 Hz) at 0:50.6. It closes on the tonic (A2 → E4 → Fk4 → E4 → D4 → E3).
